name: Captain Atwell

facts.text: Atwell's blows bleed for 65 every 3 seconds for 30 seconds.
Every named of the Hall takes no damage once drawn past its tether, and walks back to its post.

story: Captain Atwell was the first of the watch to be cut on the Summoners' road, by something no one saw, and the cut never closed. He carried it to his post and died of it there, and now every wound he gives opens the same way, bleeding steadily for half a minute. The last report of the Pennine watch mentions him by name. He sits at the captains' table as if waiting for the healer who never came, and rises when anyone else comes in. When the riders came from Camelot, the dead at this post turned to watch them go, and have watched the door ever since.
legend: Atwell's blows bleed: 65 every three seconds for half a minute, and they stack on a tank that is not healed. Fight him at the captains' table where he stands, never drag him; off his post he cannot be hurt. The watch fights better together: clear the posts nearest it first.

aggro: The road is held. Turn back.

lairEntry: Captains at their table. Their wounds never closed.
